posts.title: The shop is open
posts.body:
There are three new buttons at the very bottom of the screen now.

The bell is announcements, so that is where you are reading this. The podium is the leaderboard. The purple tag is the shop. There are no words under them, so hold one down for a second and it will tell you what it is. Play and Levels have not moved.

The shop is the big one. 36 things to buy, split into nozzles, hoses and water colours. Some of them are serious and some of them are not: there is a dragon, a rubber duck, an old boot and a fish head. The hoses come striped now too, including a candy cane, a tiger, a snake and a full rainbow. The water can be lemonade, slime, lava, liquid gold or a few others.

You pay for all of it in jits, the purple coins. Jits come from stars and nothing else. One star is 2 jits, two stars is 4, and three stars is 7. You only get the third star when every single person and pet gets out alive, which is why it is worth going back to a level you have already beaten. Clearing a level again pays again.

There are 30 levels now across three seasons. Season 2 has been rebuilt from scratch: you are putting out fires in ordinary houses from that country, with the famous landmark lit up on the skyline behind you. Big Ben behind a London terrace, the Eiffel Tower behind a Paris apartment block, and so on. Season 3 is ten new places with something worth looking at in each one.

Go and spend your jits.

posts.title: Big update
posts.body:
Ten different places to fight fires in now. One of them is an airport - look up and you'll see planes going over with their lights blinking.

There's smoke drifting through the air now too, and people, kids and pets in the windows to rescue before their time runs out.

Shop coming really soon.

posts.title: Announcements are here
posts.body:
You can now read messages from me right inside the game.

This update also adds profiles, five different places to fight fires in, people and pets to rescue, and fires that go out quicker.

More coming soon.
